description: This file defines classes related to performance monitoring and statistics within the TestLink project, specifically including tlPageStatistics for managing page performance counters and tlPerformanceCounter for individual performance metrics.

classes.name: tlPageStatistics
classes.description: Handles the 'performance' footer on web pages, collecting and displaying performance metrics.

classes.name: tlPerformanceCounter
classes.description: Represents a set of performance counters such as memory, time, and SQL query metrics.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting up performance counters.

methods.name: startPerformanceCounter
methods.description: Creates a new performance counter with specified title and type.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Outputs the performance counter details upon object destruction.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an HTML-styled string representation of performance counters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a performance counter with a database reference and type.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Outputs the performance counter metrics if echoOnDestruct is enabled.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string summary of memory, time, and SQL query metrics.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the performance counter was started.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all performance metrics and timers.

methods.name: resetSQL
methods.description: Resets SQL query and duration counters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all measurement timers and updates metrics.

methods.name: updateMemory
methods.description: Updates peak and current memory usage statistics.

methods.name: updateSQL
methods.description: Updates SQL query duration and count metrics.
